_notes_system: Play rules of the star system around a colony (game/sim/Space/StarSystem.cs). travel: impulse flight between two bodies takes seconds[0] + (seconds[1] - seconds[0]) × the distance's share of distance[0]..distance[1] (map units, clamped), so 20 s next door and 90 s across the system; neutral traffic flies neutral_scale × slower. scan: a long-range scan from a ship in orbit identifies every body within range map units of it (name, class, size, moons: knowledge Scanned), then recharges for cooldown_seconds. sweep: entering orbit of a body not yet Charted starts an orbital sensor sweep that charts it after seconds (air, pressure, temperature, gravity, possible resources); while a ship stays in orbit of a Charted body it reads it live like a satellite (incl. the structures on it). comms: while the flagship is away from the colony's body, orders to the colony and the colony's reports take delay_seconds[0] + (delay_seconds[1] - delay_seconds[0]) × the ship's distance from the colony's body as a share of distance[0]..distance[1] (clamped); none in orbit there. satellite: a satellite left at the body the flagship orbits (paid from stock) gives live readings there for good; max per player. traffic: how many neutral civilian ships fly between the bodies (ships [min, max]), which factions' civilian classes they use (ships/classes, roles listed under cargo), what each role carries (one picked per trip), how long they stay in orbit between trips, their names and registry prefixes by faction (numbers from registry_numbers). All numbers are placeholders.
